name: find_files
description: Find files by name pattern (glob). Files git ignores are left out. * stays within one directory, ** crosses directories; a pattern with no / matches file names anywhere. Paths are shown escaped (\n, \t, \\ and \xNN for other control or non-UTF-8 bytes). Example: {"pattern":"**/*.test.ts"}

path.description: Directory to look in, relative to the worktree root; leave out for all of it

repo.description: The slot to look in; leave out when there is one
